about: The team on the owner's second account (task 40), in the format of data/owner_team.json, never over it. Charged moves are listed in the order of the buttons on the phone, left then right; the live player checks that order against the button labels when each Pokemon first comes out. cp is what the party screen shows; ivs are not read yet, so the usual spread is assumed. Jellicent's fast move is checked against how fast its buttons fill. Jellicent's Bubble Beam became Ice Beam on 2026-11-08 (a TM; the owner).
